name: dcp-dag-compression-fix
goal: Prevent DCP from compressing active DAG node content by adding next_step() as a compression boundary marker via prompt override files.

subtasks.name: Write DCP prompt override files
subtasks.description: Create opencode/dcp-prompts/overrides/ with 4 override files that inject DAG-node awareness. Rule: content after the most recent next_step() call is the active node and is off-limits for compression until next_step() is called again.

subtasks.name: Verify dcp.jsonc needs no changes
subtasks.description: Confirm nudgeForce, nudgeFrequency, and iterationNudgeThreshold are compatible with the override approach. Document findings.
